name: Wadgassen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wadgassen (a black eagle on yellow, a red cross on white and a fleur-de-lis on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Wadgassen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Wadgassen arms — eagle, cross and fleur-de-lis
